description: Navigate the connected browser tab to a URL, or reload it in place with { reload: true } (add { hard: true } to bypass the cache). e.g. {"url":"/settings"}

hard.description: With reload:true, bypass the browser cache (Cmd+Shift+R).

reload.description: Reload the current page instead of navigating (replaces the former standalone refresh tool).

sessionId.description: Target a specific tab. Omit unless you mean one — see instructions.

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the page to come back (the SDK reconnecting at the new URL, or under the same id on a reload) before answering confirmed:false.

name: reticle_navigate
